basic_info.description: Conveniently located on the border of Nob & Russian Hills in a boutique Edwardian 6-unit bldg, this sophisticated 2BD, 1BA flat was meticulously renovated w/ high-end finishes & modern conveniences. Featuring 1021(+/-) sqft of living space, the residence boasts an open-concept floorplan, w/ a modern designer aesthetic, incl wide-planked white oak hdwd flrs w/ radiant heat and 10-foot soaring ceilings. Enter through a gated entrance into a spacious first-floor flat. The primary BD includes a built-in King-sized bed, California Closet system, and double-hung windows w/ custom blinds & draperies. The cozy 2nd BD offers tailor-made window shades & an Alpha closet system. The modern bath is designed w/ a deep soaking tub, designer subway tile, Caesarstone vanity & Hansgrohe fixtures. The unit is highlighted by a lg modern great rm w/ an open chef's kitchen incl s/s Bosch and Fisher & Paykel appliances, ample custom cabinetry & lg Caesarstone-topped b'fast bar. The living rm extends through west-facing windows to a Zen private rear patio w/ modern horizontal slat fencing. Add'l features: custom paint, in-unit front-loading LG w/d, ethernet wiring, Nest thermostat, Aiphone intercom & storage. With a Walkscore 95, enjoy close proximity to Hyde/Polk/Union Streets shops, dining, wine bars!
